source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
See if it's a large emitter.
3. Try to get more raw data from the TTEE
4. Extract the raw data out of the pdf
5. Make a table of emission values
6. Calculate a summary metric for the table
7. Compare to the regulatory threshold for an I-Class permit
8. Download any publicly available emissions reports
9. Search for a newspaper story or public comments
10. Include the full monitoring data and calculations in your report
11. Notify TCEQ of the "uncontrolled emissions" if the threshold is exceeded

This document describes a process to detect excessive industrial emissions. These notes form an iterative, systematic approach to completing the calculations necessary to determine the emissions rate of a monitored pollution stream. The following steps are to be applied to historical monitoring records, after which the daily emissions rate can be compared to the TCEQ's permit-triggering threshold for an I-Class
